$comment: Machine-readable declaration of registered /api/v1/admin routes that admin-api.json intentionally does not document. Read by scripts/ci/openapi-drift-check.py: a registered admin route that is neither documented, listed here, nor derived as a 405 Method Not Allowed responder fails the drift gate, and an entry here that is no longer registered (or has since been documented) also fails it. Absence from the bundle is therefore always a deliberate, reviewable declaration. Routes registered only to answer 405 for a non-primary verb are NOT listed here: they are derived from their MapMethods registration by derive_method_not_allowed_routes (honua-server#3063).

reasons.undocumented-backlog: Live, supported admin route that the curated bundle does not yet describe. Temporary. Zero entries as of the honua-server#3063 burn-down; the code stays so a future route can be parked here deliberately rather than silently.
reasons.non-production-fixture: Route registered only when a Development/Test-only fixture flag is enabled. OperateObservabilityFixtureOptions fails host startup if the flag is set outside Development or Test, so a Production host never serves it. Permanent exclusion: advertising it would generate control-plane SDK methods that cannot succeed against a real deployment.
